description.value:
Requirement You are holding ammunition intended for a different firearm than the one you are loading.

Ammunition that was never meant for this weapon fits fine if you are impolite about it.

Load the wrong ammunition anyway. The weapon fires normally this round. At the end of that round it gains a Failure Range if it did not have one, or gains the Jammed condition if it did — including a Good Gun, which is the only thing on this page that will do that to one.

cinderfall.incomplete: (Failure Range/Jammed are homebrew item-state changes with no selector). This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
